court: In the High Court of Madras
appellants: Consolidated Construction Consortium Limited, Rep. by its Managing Director, Mr. S. Sivaramakrishnan .…. Petitioner;
respondents: Tamil Nadu Water Supply and Drainage Board (TWAD), Rep. by its Executive Engineer .…. Respondent.
advocates: For Respondent : Mr. M. Arockiaraj, Standing Counsel
judgment_text:
Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the Respondent to consider the Petitioner's representation dated 14.08.2019 and 17.08.2019 and accept the Bank Guarantee for a sum of Rs. 93,45,548/-.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

P.D. Audikesavalu, J.:— The Petitioner has furnished a bank guarantee for a sum of Rs. 4,55,10,000/- in respect of the contract for the work undertaken to be completed to the Respondent. It is submitted that though the contract has been completed, the Respondent has been insisting for renewal of the entire amount of the bank guarantee for Rs. 4,55,10,000/- (expiring on 30.09.2019) and it would suffice to furnish bank guarantee for the sum of Rs. 93,45,548/-, which is 5% of the value of the work involved as per the agreed terms of contract.

2. This Court during the earlier hearings had required the parties to sort out the disputes through mutual negotiation, but it is reported today that they could not arrive at an amicable settlement.

3. Learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Respondent, on instructions, submits that there have been defects in the work carried out by the Petitioner, which works out to a sum of Rs. 1,13,65,140/- and the if re-tendered, it would work out to a sum of Rs. 1,95,63,601/-.

4. Having regard to the aforesaid submissions made, the Petitioner shall furnish four bank guarantees of Rs. 50,00,000/- each aggregating to the sum of Rs. 2,00,00,000/- in favour of the Respondent which shall be kept in force till 16.12.2020. As and when the defects in the work to the value of Rs. 50,00,000/- is rectified satisfactorily at every stage to that extent, the Respondent shall release each bank guarantee.

5. The Writ Petition is disposed on the aforesaid terms. Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed. No costs.
